name: Two-Auxiliary Sections Are Strictly Maximum-Generated
scope: Finite binary classes under the minor-atlas displayed-coordinate conventions.
statement: Every two-auxiliary section is maximum-generated, while $(Q_2\setminus\{11\})\times Q_3$ requires three auxiliaries.
proof: Every two-auxiliary section is maximum-generated, while $(Q_2\setminus\{11\})\times Q_3$ requires three auxiliaries.
